body_markdown:
Hello,


Panes are here! Keep multiple parts of your outline open side by side. We’ve also improved editing, Calendar, mobile, and reorganized the Help Center.


## **Panes**


- Much requested and finally here, you can now open Panes in Workflowy.
- Panes keep multiple parts of your Workflowy outline open side by side in the same window.
- Keep your[Today](https://workflowy.com/help/plan-with-calendar) node open while you work, reference notes while drafting a document, or move nodes between parts of your outline without losing your place.
- Each pane is a view of an existing node, not a duplicate. Any edits you make in a pane update the original everywhere it appears.
- To create a new pane, press the ‘New pane’ button in the header. To open a specific node, hold` Alt` (` Option` on Mac) and click its bullet, choose` Open in Pane` from the node menu, or type` /open in pane` .
- **Note:** Panes are available in desktop browsers and the Workflowy desktop apps. No mobile support (yet).
- For more, including keyboards shortcuts, visit the[Panes help doc](https://workflowy.com/help/panes) .


## **Improvements**


- **[Tables](https://workflowy.com/help/tables) :** Move a row using the standard Move Up and Move Down[keyboard shortcuts](https://workflowy.com/help/hotkeys) .
- **Inline code:** Typing two spaces at the end of inline code returns you to regular text.
- **[Dividers](https://workflowy.com/help/dividers) :** Pressing Delete immediately after typing a Divider title no longer turns it back into a bullet.
- **[PDF previews](https://workflowy.com/help/files-images#view-pdf-files) :** Closing a PDF no longer leaves a weird black rectangle over Workflowy.
- **[Search](https://workflowy.com/help/search) :** Use` has:children` to find nodes with child nodes.
- **[Calendar](https://workflowy.com/help/plan-with-calendar) :**` Move to Date` is now available from the node menu.
- **[Google Calendar](https://workflowy.com/help/google-calendar) :** Sync recovers more reliably from temporary connection failures.
- **[Mobile](https://workflowy.com/help/apps-devices) :** The indent, outdent, undo, and redo keyboard accessory buttons now update immediately. No more lag.
- **[Settings](https://workflowy.com/help/settings) :** A redesigned Settings screen brings clearer sections, consistent controls, and simpler navigation.
- **Billing:** If a subscription payment is delayed, Workflowy now recognizes the existing subscription and prevents you from starting another checkout.
- **iOS:** Upgrade to Pro directly from Settings.
- **Login:** Password users can[switch back to emailed login codes](https://workflowy.com/accounts/switch-to-login-code/) .


## **Help Documents**


- We’ve reorganized the[Workflowy Help Center](https://workflowy.com/help) around common tasks and expanded our guides.
